verified: Sierra said on Nov. 23 that it raised a $1.75 billion Series F at a $30 billion valuation, led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners, with Benchmark, Sequoia, Greenoaks, GV and Tiger Global all returning, according to the company's own announcement and CMSWire.
unconfirmed: That the valuation doubled within six months (implying a prior round near $15 billion) rests on TechCrunch's reporting rather than a figure in Sierra's announcement; the sources also give no revenue, customer-count or booking details to support the demand claim.

verified: Sierra 于 11 月 23 日宣布完成 17.5 亿美元 F 轮融资，估值 300 亿美元；本轮由 Greenoaks 和 Lightspeed Venture Partners 领投，Benchmark、Sequoia、GV、Tiger Global 等原有领投方全部继续参与（Sierra 官方博客与 CMSWire 报道一致）。
unconfirmed: “六个月内估值翻倍”一说来自 TechCrunch 的报道标题，Sierra 官方博客只给出本轮 300 亿美元估值，未列出上一轮的具体数字；融资的具体条款、营收与客户规模、资金用途，以及独立第三方对估值的核实，均未披露。

titles.en: Sierra raises $1.75B Series F at reported $30B valuation
titles.zh: Sierra 完成 17.5 亿美元 F 轮融资，估值据报六个月内翻倍至 300 亿美元
